Scenario fixture: rgaa-img-alt-present (RGAA 1.1.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form iap_case_NN. An exposed <img> with no alt and no other text alternative fails 1.1.1, except a spacer, which is decorative and fails 1.2.1 alone (rgaa-img-no-alt-decorative).

A. No text alternative (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: photo with no alt
02 — FAIL: alt of only spaces
03 — FAIL: 1 by 1 px image that is a link's only content

B. A text alternative (PASS)

04 — PASS: alt text
05 — PASS: empty alt
06 — PASS: aria-label

C. Out of scope

07 — NOT APPLICABLE: spacer with no alt (1.2.1)
08 — NOT APPLICABLE: hidden with aria-hidden
